$comment: Integration tests allowed to skip in CI (orazaka-studio#98). Each entry: component, class (fully qualified), reason. It only shrinks: a stale entry fails. formerClass = the name before the Sovkora rename (krizaka-internal#2659): both names are accepted while the rename lands; remove the field once sovkora-engine's rename PR is merged.

allowed.reason: Live test of the semantic cache: it needs a real embedding model (bge-m3 through Ollama, ORAZAKA_LIVE_OLLAMA_URL) that no CI runner has; it skips itself by design and runs by hand against a real Ollama. Its container-backed twin PgVectorSemanticCacheStoreIT runs in CI.

noIntegrationTests.reason: Contract libraries (jobs-api, persistence-app-api, crypto): interfaces, records and pure functions covered by unit tests; no container or service to integrate. A new IT makes this entry stale.
